[SWS_DM_00145] Allow only one simultaneous clear DTC operation for one DiagnosticMemoryDestination
⌈
If a Diagnostic Client is clearing the
DTCs of a DiagnosticMemoryDestination the DM shall lock the clear DTC opera-
tion for all other clients requesting to clear the DTCs of the same DiagnosticMemo-
ryDestination.
